name: Pareto Support Proofs
description: This source engine is version 0.6.2 and is included in the published OPTL-R1-20261017 companion, released on 17 October 2026 (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23440598). The DOI identifies the complete companion distribution rather than a later source-only snapshot. Retained examples, results, protocol and validation files belong to historical engine 0.6.1 and are not outputs of this successor. Exact proof objects and standalone verification for non-negative weighted-sum supportability and unsupportedness in finite multi-objective optimisation. Historical software version 0.6.1: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20832039. Version-family DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20832038.
softwareRequirements: No third-party runtime dependency for the standalone checker
